title: RTP-premium
description: Advanced random teleportation plugin with 5 modes, safe location finder, GUI menu, cooldowns, and 10 languages. Supports Normal, Far, Nether, End, and Near-Player teleport with 12 safety checks.
body:
# 🌍 RTP Premium — Advanced Random Teleportation

The most feature-rich and safest random teleportation plugin for Paper/Spigot servers.

## ✨ Features

- **5 Teleport Modes** — Normal, Far, Nether, End, Near Player
- **12 Safety Checks** — Never teleport into lava, blocks, cliffs, or deep water
- **Beautiful GUI Menu** — Click to teleport, no commands needed
- **Per-mode Cooldowns** — Configurable for each mode
- **Warmup Timer** — Cancel on move, with countdown titles
- **Particles & Sounds** — Beautiful teleport effects
- **10 Languages** — EN, RU, ES, DE, FR, PT, ZH, JA, KO, TR
- **Fully Configurable** — Every setting can be changed
- **Lightweight** — No lag, async location finding
- **Permission Support** — Per-mode permissions

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/rtp` | Open teleport GUI menu |
| `/rtp normal` | Normal teleport (up to 4000 blocks) |
| `/rtp far` | Far teleport (up to 10000 blocks) |
| `/rtp nether` | Nether teleport |
| `/rtp end` | End teleport |
| `/rtp player` | Teleport near a random player |
| `/rtp help` | Show help |
| `/rtp reload` | Reload config (admin) |

## 🔒 Safety System

| Check | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ✅ Solid ground | Never teleport into air |
| ✅ No lava | Lava is dangerous |
| ✅ No fire | Fire and campfires blocked |
| ✅ No cactus | Cactus, berries, roses blocked |
| ✅ Water depth | Max 3 blocks deep |
| ✅ Cliff check | No cliffs nearby (10 blocks) |
| ✅ Ceiling lava | Check for lava above (Nether) |
| ✅ End platform | 60% solid blocks required |
| ✅ Spawn distance | Min 100 blocks from spawn |
| ✅ Air space | 2 blocks of air for body |
| ✅ Vanish respect | Skip vanished players |
| ✅ World check | Correct world targeting |

## 🌐 Languages

English, Russian, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish

## 📋 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `rtp.use` | Open RTP menu | true |
| `rtp.normal` | Normal teleport | true |
| `rtp.far` | Far teleport | true |
| `rtp.nether` | Nether teleport | true |
| `rtp.end` | End teleport | true |
| `rtp.player` | Near player teleport | true |
| `rtp.reload` | Reload config | op |
| `rtp.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass cooldown | op |

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Paper / Purpur / Folia 1.21+
- Java 21+
## 🔐 LuckPerms Support

The plugin uses standard Bukkit permissions, which means it works with **any permission plugin** — including:

- ✅ LuckPerms (recommended)
- ✅ PermissionsEx (PEX)
- ✅ GroupManager
- ✅ UltraPermissions
- ✅ Any other Vault-compatible permission plugin

### Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `rtp.use` | Open RTP menu | true |
| `rtp.normal` | Normal teleport (4000 blocks) | true |
| `rtp.far` | Far teleport (10000 blocks) | true |
| `rtp.nether` | Nether teleport | true |
| `rtp.end` | End teleport | true |
| `rtp.player` | Near player teleport | true |
| `rtp.reload` | Reload config | op |
| `rtp.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass all cooldowns | op |

### LuckPerms Examples

```
# Allow VIP to bypass cooldown
/lp group vip permission set rtp.bypass.cooldown true

# Restrict far teleport to admins only
/lp group default permission set rtp.far false

# Give all RTP permissions to a player
/lp user PlayerName permission set rtp.* true

# Disable RTP for guests
/lp group guest permission set rtp.use false
```

### Per-mode Cooldowns by Group

You can combine permissions with the cooldown system. For example:

1. Set cooldowns in `config.yml`:
```yaml
cooldowns:
  normal: 60
  far: 300
  nether: 180
  end: 180
  player: 600
```

2. Allow VIP to bypass them:
```
/lp group vip permission set rtp.bypass.cooldown true
```

VIP players will have no cooldown, while default players will have to wait!
